items.source_en:
Technician L. Wanyan - GENSEC Level 02
Experiment Report EXP-GDY072-020

This will be the last entry for the GDY072 Grid. I have hit a solid wall in the experiment and can't progress beyond this point. My knowledge of astronautics and ship systems is decent, but for the experiment to be a success, we need people with a high degree of expertise in those fields. Every request I've made to that extent has been denied or ignored.

I am therefore terminating this experiment until another technician wishes to take over or Chief Technician Bayu resigns, and we get someone who actually knows what they're doing in this place.
